findings.claim: Under the offline lock, start() takes LangSmith tracers out of the per-call config only. Pregel.with_config(callbacks=[tracer]) returns a copy (which keeps the OfflineLocked class) whose self.config holds the tracer (langgraph/pregel/main.py:1000-1008). Pregel.stream then runs ensure_config(self.config, config) (main.py:2862), which merges self.config's callbacks back in (langgraph/_internal/_config.py:398-401) after the filter. invoke goes through the same stream. The LangChainTracer therefore traces every node run, statement data among the inputs, under the lock. This fails R29's 'a LangSmith tracer handed in with the run's callbacks is taken out of them' and P18. test_p18_a_graph_copied_by_with_config_keeps_the_locks_rules binds only tags, so it does not cover this. Found by reading the code; not run, because the shell was denied.
